先說明自己是新生、轉學生、轉系生或其他身分，帶原修課程與成績資料詢問。請承辦確認: State whether you are a new student, transfer student, a student changing departments, or have another status, and bring information about previous courses and grades. Ask whether applications are still open and which rules apply; similar course names do not automatically mean credits can transfer.
在可申請的期間填寫抵免系統並列印表格，備妥原校成績證明正本。依公告送開課單位與就: During the application period, complete the credit transfer system, print the form, and prepare the original transcript from your previous school. Follow the notice to obtain approval from the course-offering unit and your department, then submit it to the Registration and Curriculum Division for further review; online entry alone is not completion.
先查已核准抵免的科目，再問是否仍需自行調整本學期課表。若結果和申請內容不同，拿申: Check which credits have been approved, then ask whether you need to adjust this semester’s timetable yourself. If the result differs from your application, bring the application form and transcript to ask; submitting documents or passing the first review does not finish the process.
